0022600141.text: The Utah Jazz (1-2, 11th in the West) host the San Antonio Spurs (1-2, 9th in the West) in the fifth game of the Jazz's season, with Utah 1-1 at home and on a one-game losing streak while San Antonio is on a one-game winning streak. Utah is missing Jaxson Hayes (shoulder soreness), Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain), and Trey Alexander (knee bruise), and San Antonio is without Jayden Quaintance (knee surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf strain). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in 2025-26 the Jazz lost the season series 1-2, including a 126-109 loss in Salt Lake City on January 22, 2026.
